entry.title: Ripple Files Civil Appeal Pre-Argument Statement Against SEC: Key Takeaways

On Thursday, October 24, Ripple Labs filed the Civil Appeal Pre-Argument Statement, known as Form C, in its case with the US Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC). The appeal focuses on four main arguments. First, the company challenges the definition of an “investment contract” under Section 5 of the Securities Act of 1933.
